name: Saptarshi Debnath
summary: Visionary Technical Architect and Staff Engineer with expansive expertise in designing, scaling, and modernizing high-latency, cloud-native distributed systems. Proven track record of leading architectural transformations, driving organizational engineering standards, and mentoring cross-functional teams to deliver highly available, zero-trust infrastructure. Seeking to leverage deep expertise in system design and microservices as a Principal Architect to drive enterprise-wide technical strategy.

experience.web_summary: Architecting global-scale infrastructure and driving engineering excellence across the organization.
highlights: Leading technical strategy and architectural design for high-scale software infrastructure, supporting millions of transactions on hybrid cloud environments.
Serving as an organizational multiplier by defining software design patterns and best practices adopted by 12+ cross-functional engineering pods.
Directing large-scale performance optimizations for distributed microservices, ensuring single-digit millisecond latency for critical path APIs.
Mentoring senior engineers and advocating for zero-trust infrastructure and cloud-native resilience standards.
Technologies: Java, Cloud Infrastructure, Distributed Systems, Microservices Architecture.

experience.web_summary: Architected secure, enterprise-grade solutions and spearheaded digital transformation initiatives for high-visibility clients.
highlights: Designed and delivered complex enterprise software solutions with a focus on scalability and strict security compliance.
Spearheaded digital transformation initiatives, modernizing legacy infrastructure into resilient cloud-native services.
Mentored cross-functional engineering teams on modern development methodologies and high-scale architectural standards.

experience.web_summary: Spearheaded the transition of monolithic reservation systems to reactive, cloud-native microservices.
highlights: Spearheaded the strategic transition of global monolithic applications to resilient, reactive microservices using Play/Akka and Spring WebFlux.
Designed and scaled high-performance RESTful microservices for global reservations and property management systems.
Championed organizational performance standards, tuning enterprise APIs to achieve single-digit millisecond latency.
Technologies: Java 11/8, Play/Akka, Spring WebFlux, Couchbase, Red Hat OpenShift.

experience.web_summary: Managed a complex travel portal microservices ecosystem and automated deployment pipelines.
highlights: Led the maintenance and feature development of a travel portal ecosystem consisting of 8 distinct microservices.
Orchestrated automated testing and deployment strategies using Selenium, Jenkins, and Docker.
Managed deployments across multiple environments (DEV, QA, PROD) using Red Hat OpenShift.
Technologies: Java 8, Spring Boot, ActiveMQ, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, Redis, Angular 2.

experience.web_summary: Key contributor to system automation and AWS infrastructure certification initiatives.
highlights: Built an automated Software Intake Form workflow using AngularJS and Spring MVC.
Certified AWS AMI images using Java 8 and Cucumber/Gherkin to ensure security and compliance.
Automated virtual development environments utilizing Vagrant and VirtualBox.
Technologies: Java 8, Shell Scripting, Vagrant, MongoDB, Node JS.

experience.web_summary: Onsite Coordinator and Lead for digital marketing and e-commerce platforms.
highlights: Acted as Onsite Coordinator/Team Lead for the maintenance of oncology e-marketing websites.
Developed and optimized web platforms based on a proprietary Struts 1.x framework.
Managed cross-functional communications between onsite clients and offshore teams.
Technologies: Java 1.7, JSP, jQuery, Mootools.

experience.web_summary: Developed custom reporting solutions for large-scale banking infrastructure.
highlights: Generated and transmitted highly customized reports between bank infrastructure and clients.
Developed complex data extraction and reporting logic using Mainframe FOCUS and Actuate.
Technologies: Mainframe FOCUS, DB2, VSAM, JCL.

experience.web_summary: Initial exploration into mobile game development and OpenGL graphics.
highlights: Developed an OpenGL ES 1.1 based iPhone game 'Crazee Cube'.
Gained foundational experience in C++, iOS SDK, and computer graphics.
